What are the $xy$-coordinates of the point shown in the axes above?
question.worked_solution:
To find the coordinates of the point, we inspect its position along the $x$ and $y$ axes.

The point is $2$ units to the right of the origin, in the positive direction of the $x$-axis. So, the point has an $x$-coordinate of $2.$

Additionally, the point is $4$ units above the origin, in the positive direction of the $y$-axis. So, the point has a $y$-coordinate of $4.$

The point has an $x$-coordinate of $2$ and a $y$-coordinate of $4,$ so its coordinates are $(2,4).$
